details: Bitcoin has slipped below $64,000, and Ethereum also saw declines, as market participants show caution ahead of the highly anticipated US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report scheduled for Wednesday. Institutional Bitcoin ETF flows turned negative, breaking a seven-day positive streak, signaling reduced buying aggression at current price levels.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Slide as Investors Await US Inflation Data

details: The Harmony blockchain platform has confirmed an exploit leading to the unauthorized minting of approximately 4 billion ONE tokens. This significant increase in supply raises concerns about token value and network security for investors.
title: Harmony Confirms Exploit, 4 Billion ONE Tokens Unauthorizedly Minted

details: An attacker successfully drained close to 200,000 XRP from the Coreum Bridge by exploiting a software vulnerability that allowed the system to misinterpret fake deposits as legitimate ones. The bridge has been temporarily halted, and forensic investigations are underway.
title: Coreum Bridge Suffers Exploit, Nearly 200,000 XRP Drained

details: Crypto asset management firm Bitwise has laid off 14% of its workforce, attributing the decision to the ongoing market downturn. This move reflects continued challenges faced by companies within the cryptocurrency industry.
title: Bitwise Announces 14% Staff Reduction Amidst Market Downturn

details: Coinbase has launched derivatives trading for professional investors in the UK, offering over 170 contracts across cryptocurrencies, commodities, equities, and foreign exchange, with leverage options up to 50 times. This expansion broadens institutional access to crypto-related financial products.
title: Coinbase Expands UK Derivatives Trading with Up to 50x Leverage

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is set to hold its first significant rulemaking meeting concerning "Regulation Crypto" on August 14th. This meeting could provide crucial updates and potentially introduce new guidelines for digital assets.
title: SEC Schedules Key 'Regulation Crypto' Rulemaking Meeting for August 14
